description:
Search Datadog logs with grep-like text filtering. Actions: search (find logs), aggregate (count/group). Key filters: keyword (text grep), pattern (regex), service, host, status (error/warn/info). Time ranges: "1h", "3d@11:45:23".
CORRELATION: Logs contain dd.trace_id in attributes for linking to traces and APM metrics.
SAMPLING: Use sample:"diverse" for error investigation (dedupes by message pattern), sample:"spread" for time distribution.
TOKEN TIP: Use compact:true to reduce payload size (strips heavy fields) when querying large volumes.

compact.description: Strip custom attributes for token efficiency. Keeps: id, timestamp, service, host, status, message (truncated), dd.trace_id, dd.span_id, pod_name, kube_namespace, kube_container_name, error info

from.description: Start time. Formats: ISO 8601, relative (30s, 15m, 2h, 7d), precise (3d@11:45:23, yesterday@14:00)

keyword.description: Simple text search - finds logs containing this text (grep-like). Merged with query using AND

limit.description: Maximum number of logs to return (default: 200)

pattern.description: Regex pattern to match in log message (grep -E style). Example: "ERROR.*timeout|connection refused"

query.description: Log search query (Datadog syntax). Examples: "error", "service:my-service status:error", "error AND timeout"

sample.description: Sampling mode: first (chronological, default), spread (evenly across time range), diverse (distinct message patterns)

to.description: End time. Same formats as "from". Example: from="3d@11:45:23" to="3d@12:55:34"

name: logs
